# Word Clock (`wordClock`)

Spells the time in a glowing letter grid: just after ten, nearly half past.

- Type: scene (draws its own image; put it first)
- Reacts to: clock
- Cost: medium (~3.1 ms/frame at 5K on a Pro GPU)
- Built-in styles: Word Clock, Printed Words

## Params

| key | label | kind | range / options | default |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `face` | Typeface | menu | 0 Sans · 1 Serif · 2 Rounded | 0 (Sans) |
| `weight` | Weight | slider | 0 … 1 | 0.3 |
| `glow` | Glow | slider | 0 … 1 | 0.6 |
| `unlit` | Unlit Letters | slider | 0 … 0.4 | 0.12 |
| `period` | Time of Day | toggle | 0 / 1 | on |
| `size` | Size | slider | 0.5 … 1.15 | 1 |
